description: Kynema-UGF is the National Laboratory of the Rockies and Sandia team's parallel solver for incompressible flows on unstructured grids. Formerly called Nalu-Wind, it was renamed in 2026 to reflect broader computational-fluid-dynamics uses. Inputs are meshes, boundary conditions, fluid properties and numerical settings; outputs are simulated flow fields for energy-system studies. Spatial resolution and simulated duration are user-configured. Source is free under a three-clause BSD licence, with theory, verification and build manuals. The code uses Trilinos and parallel scientific libraries and supports CPU and GPU configurations. A limitation is that results depend on discretisation, turbulence models and boundary conditions, while compilation requires several specialist dependencies. Kynema-UGF can model atmospheric flows around energy infrastructure. OpenFOAM (model-openfoam) is a related CFD resource. The repository cites the ExaWind wind-turbine study. No mesh, model archive or solver was downloaded.
